author: Harry
text:
milkeyway wrote: Please guide.

the point of the exercise is to mark one (or more) turning points and look left to see why it turned there. i do this every time i want to see what a swing high/low was a reaction to, obviously most are a reaction to either a previous RBD DBR or to an FL. where it hit or if it engulfed is important too, so make it a habit and go investigate every turn
